newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end higher in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end higher in slow trade.

text.p: Jakarta stocks closed higher on Tuesday but overall trading was slow as investors were sidelined ahead of Thursday's general election, brokers said.
Brokers said the rise was due to bargain-hunting in blue chip counters such as Telkom, toll road operator Citra Marga and Bank Negara Indonesia.

The Jakarta Composite Index closed 5.65 points, or 0.85 percent, higher at 668.85 points. Gainers led losers by 82 to 43 with 61 counters unchanged. Total turn-over was estimated at about 316 billion rupiah, against 280 billion rupiah on Thursday.
